whenToUse: When a response is attributive — good/bad, yes/no, proportions — or a count (defects, complaints), and its relationship with predictors is to be modelled: binary logistic, Poisson or negative binomial, detected automatically on request.
name: Regression (Attributive)
description: Binary logistic, Poisson, and negative binomial regression for attributive/count data
autoDetectBinary: Response has exactly 2 values → binary logistic regression recommended.
autoDetectPoisson: Response is non-negative integer (count data) → Poisson regression recommended.
autoDetectNegbin: Response is count data with overdispersion (variance > mean) → negative binomial regression recommended.
autoDetectProportion: Response contains proportions (0–1) → binary logistic regression recommended.
autoDetectProportionAmbiguous: Response contains proportions in [0, 1]. Grouped binomial regression requires a trials column per observation; without it the likelihood is ill-defined.
autoDetectDefault: Response is non-negative → Poisson regression used as default.
qqTitle: Normal Q-Q Plot of Deviance Residuals
overdispersionHint: Overdispersion detected (χ²/df > 1.5). Consider using negative binomial regression instead of Poisson.
errorNoX: Please select at least one X variable.
errorTooFew: At least 3 valid data rows required.
errorTooFewForP: More data rows than model parameters required.
errorNotBinary: Binomial regression requires a binary response (exactly 2 distinct values).
errorNoConverge: IRLS did not converge. Try a different method or check data quality.
errorInvalidInput: Please enter valid numbers for all predictors.
warnSeparation: Possible separation detected — coefficients may be unreliable. Check data for predictors that perfectly separate Y.
warnSmallN: Small sample relative to number of parameters (n/p < 10). Results may be unreliable.
warnFewEvents: Few events per predictor (EPV = {epv} < 10). Coefficients and p-values may be biased.
warnSlowConverge: Model required many iterations to converge — may indicate poor conditioning.
warnOverdispersion: Overdispersion detected in Poisson model. Consider switching to negative binomial.
warnQuasiActivated: Quasi-Poisson active (φ = {phi}). Standard errors and confidence intervals were scaled by √φ.
warnSeparationStrong: Complete or quasi-complete separation detected. Coefficients and standard errors are unreliable — drop the separating predictor or merge classes.
warnThetaUnstable: θ estimate did not converge (θ = {theta}). Data are likely near-Poisson — switch the method to Poisson, or fix θ manually.
columnTrialsHint: Number of trials per observation (grouped binomial regression). Y is then read as success proportion.
errorProportionRange: Y must be a proportion in [0, 1] when a trials column is provided.
errorTrialsInvalid: Trial counts must be positive finite numbers (≥ 1).
predictCiUnavailable: Confidence interval unavailable — design matrix is singular.
swapSuccessTitle: Swap classes — flip success/failure and refit
saveAsModelHint: Persists the model project-wide. Selectable in the Response Optimizer.
errColumnMissing: A selected column no longer exists. Please check the selection.
confRejected: Please enter a value between 0 and 100.
saveBlocked: Without a converged fit no model can be saved.
saveFailed: The model could not be saved.
swapUnavailable: Without a binary response there is no success class to swap.
noWorksheet: No worksheet in the project. Please create a worksheet with data first.
